amendments.what: defined the Sharpe statistics operationally: the gate keeps the paired daily long_short_return delta (registered block bootstrap, CI low > 0) plus rank_ic point >= -0.002 and turnover point <= +0.10; the winner statistic is the paired long_short_sharpe delta with its own month-aware block-bootstrap interval (Sharpe recomputed inside every draw), and the one-standard-error tie rule uses that interval's standard error
amendments.reason: the first draft wrote 'long_short_sharpe: paired daily delta CI low > 0'; a Sharpe delta has no daily pairing, so the gate statistic and the winner statistic are now stated explicitly; declared before any dev10 score was read (nov2023 artifacts existed on disk but unread)

goal.request_ref: user instruction 2026-10-28: widen the development window set from five to ten months and replay three zero-training post-processing transforms on saved predictions; no training, no retraining, no model change
why: the five old months deliver 104 trading days; adding feb2024 and may2024 and jul2024 and aug2024 and sep2024 delivers 203 in total (+99), roughly doubling the paired-difference sample
the added months lie entirely outside every checkpoint training interval and outside the sealed interval [2024-10-08, 2025-01-01]
winsorizing, volatility scaling and cross-sectional rank centering train no parameters, so the study is replay plus arithmetic on saved scores
goal.status_claim: no score of any new month existed when this file was written; no checkpoint was run on the new months; the plan was authored and hashed before the replay started

windows.trading_day_source: date column of data/cpt_jyc_2026_vwap/cpt_jyc_2026_vwap_YYYY-MM.parquet, eight clocks per day
windows.training_boundary: every replayed checkpoint trained on bars ending on or before 2023-10-31; the earliest replay window starts 2023-11-01
windows.status_after_use: the five new months become development data; their never-seen status is forfeited and they may not be reported as out-of-sample evidence

replay.checkpoints_invariant: frozen weights; preprocessing dict equals the plan config (schema version 2, lookback 128, price_scale 100)

coverage_gaps.dual_patch_seed11_seed29_seed47: weights absent on this host (remote host only); excluded from the ten-month replay
coverage_gaps.927d_rung_seed11_seed29_seed47: weights absent on this host, only saved predictions exist; excluded
coverage_gaps.441d_lotB_seed53_seed59_seed61: weights absent on this host; excluded

replay.consequence: the nine-model submission blend is re-evaluated only on the five old months from stored predictions; the ten-month transform evidence uses the six-member TLOB plus MLPLOB equal blend, a trunk-count-equal subset of the same family; rule A4 keeps the nine-blend five-month check mandatory

postprocessing.stage: arithmetic on saved scores; the replay stage only produces raw scores

transform_definitions.winsor: per timestamp (date, sample time) clip each score at the empirical 1st and 99th percentile with linear interpolation
transform_definitions.rank_csz: per timestamp replace each score by the centered average rank u = (r - (n+1)/2) / (n/2), n = cross-section size; ties share the average rank; n < 2 gives 0
transform_definitions.vol_scale: sigma_i(d) = sqrt(mean over k=1..20 trading days with labels of rv_{i,d-k}^2), rv_{i,d} = sqrt(mean over the eight sample times of vwap_return^2); requires 10 observations; floor sigma per date at the 5th percentile across instruments and fill a remaining missing sigma with that date median sigma, fill count reported; score' = score / sigma

postprocessing.order_fixed: all3 applies vol, then winsor, then rank, exactly as its composition formula rank(winsor(score / sigma)); the single transforms stand alone; no other order is evaluated

ten_month.incumbent6: equal weight of the six submission incumbents
ten_month.rung132: equal weight of r132_s11 and r132_s29 and r132_s47
ten_month.rung240: equal weight of r240_s11 and r240_s29 and r240_s47
ten_month.rung441: equal weight of r441_s11 and r441_s29 and r441_s47
ten_month.cand441p264: equal weight of r441p_s11 and r441p_s29 and r441p_s47

five_month.nine_blend: equal weight of the nine archived members of runs/multiscale-replay-20261026 and runs/multiscale-replay-verify-20261026

evidence.primary_set: ten months, every delivered trading day present in every arm, paired by date

track_contract.primary: gross eval-v2 scores from the saved predictions (no neutralization)
track_contract.secondary: local BARRA-style neutralization approximation from report_platform_metrics: previous-day exposure snapshot strictly before the signal day, MAD winsorization, cross-section z-score, OLS on 10 style and 32 industry regressors
track_contract.note: gate and winner decisions use the primary track; the secondary track is reported alongside and must not contradict

inference.method: month-aware moving block bootstrap, blocks never cross a month

evidence.power_note: report the paired-difference standard error on 104 days and on 203 days and their ratio; no test on the ratio itself; no claim from a single month or a single seed

hypotheses.H1_vol: volatility scaling raises pooled long_short_sharpe by at least 10 percent relative to the raw arm while rank_ic stays within -0.002
hypotheses.H2_winsor: winsorizing lowers the worst-day loss and turnover without lowering pooled long_short_sharpe
hypotheses.H3_rank: rank centering leaves selection and turnover unchanged (null check N1) and only changes presentation or downstream blend variance

null_checks.N1_rank_selection_invariance: for every arm, daily long_short_return and turnover from rank(score) must match the raw score to <= 1e-9 on every day; a breach fails the analysis as an implementation bug
null_checks.N2_five_month_reproduction: the five old months replayed by the new run must reproduce the archived per-member rank_ic within 5e-4 absolute; the archived runs used torch 2.5.1+cu118 and this host 2.11.0+cu128, a wider spread is a caliber breach to investigate before the new months are read
null_checks.N3_coverage: every window must deliver its expected trading days with a coverage ratio of at least 0.99; otherwise the window is excluded and the exclusion is reported with the run dir

gate.long_short_return: paired daily long_short_return delta, registered month-aware block bootstrap, CI low > 0 on the ten-month set
gate.sharpe_delta: reported with its own block-bootstrap interval; not a gate condition

adoption_rules.winner: among transforms passing the gate take the largest paired long_short_sharpe delta (block-bootstrap point estimate); within one standard error of that estimate prefer the pre-declared order vol, vol_winsor, vol_rank, all3, winsor, winsor_rank, rank
adoption_rules.rank_family: N1 implies it cannot change selection or turnover; it may be adopted only as a presentation normalization, never on a Sharpe claim
adoption_rules.A4_nine_blend_confirmation: on the five old months the nine-blend transform delta must share sign and order of magnitude; a contradiction blocks adoption and the conflict is reported
adoption_rules.no_escalation: no rung or seed becomes a promotion candidate from this experiment; promotion claims remain with the sealed-interval calibration and the preregistered rung reading

cost.replay_estimate: 18 versions by 10 months on one RTX 2060 6GB; the archived 9-version by 3-window run took 984 s, so at most 90 min is expected

prohibitions: no training, fine-tuning, new checkpoints, architecture or feature changes
no read of the sealed interval and no using it for selection
no transform parameter tuning after scores are read; the 1 and 99 percent clip, 20-day window, 5 percent floor, 5-day blocks and 4000 draws are fixed here
no replacing a declared arm, window or metric after reading
no single month or single seed reported as evidence of improvement
artifacts: tests covering the transforms and null checks
